regions.name: Cinderfold Vale
regions.blurb: The first valley under the ash. The Hollows came up through the vineyards.

regions.name: The Bell Marshes
regions.blurb: Drowned chapels whose bells still ring at night. Boss: the Mire Choir.

regions.name: Gilded Causeway
regions.blurb: The Gilded Tithe sells the dead by the cartload. Boss: Abbot-Banker Corvane.

regions.name: Hollowdeep Mines
regions.blurb: The lanterns' coal came from here. Something hotter lives below. Boss: the Slag Mother.

regions.name: The Ember Wastes
regions.blurb: Burning plains where drakes nest in the slag. Boss: Ashwing.

regions.name: The Cinder Maw
regions.blurb: The crater that woke. End of the line. Boss: the Maw itself.
